storyCards.headline: Bennie And The Jets: The Performance That Defined It
storyCards.fact:
Elton John's "Bennie And The Jets" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Bennie and the Jets" (also titled "Benny & the Jets") is a song written by British musician Elton John and lyricist Bernie Taupin, and performed by John.

The song first appeared on the Goodbye Yellow Brick Road album in 1973.

"Bennie and the Jets" has been one of John's most popular songs and was performed during his appearance at Live Aid.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
